s10.old: **Build 01 DONE 2026-09-22 (uncommitted, awaiting Paul's review):** one Opus architect built the shell. Proof in `proof\01\` (30 files + `DIFFERENCES.md`). The first pass used my prompt's numbers (208px sidebar, 38px rows, 40px title); the peer session holding 02 measured M4 and showed they were wrong. The board wins: the build is now 200px, 13px nav on 25.5px rows, 31px title, card edge 226. Gold is opt-in `class="primary primary--gold"`; `.primary` stays plum (five plum buttons use it). Its four open calls were settled 09-22 (see Wave 2). The builder stalled once at 600s at a foreground server start; resuming via `SendMessage` kept its context. Peer session "Mentat console redesign build packet" owns 02.

s10.old: - **Disk 2026-09-22 23:3x:** C: hit 0.4 GB free (AppXSvc commit 37 GB led to pagefile growth). Paul: "clear 50 GB". Sparse-checkout `/*` + `!/audits/legfix5/` applied to `melange-ui-redesign-372c43`, `busy-kapitsa-3272db`, `nervous-hamilton-7e2d50`, giving 53 GB free, git status unchanged, undo = `sparse-checkout disable`. TRAP: from Git Bash the pattern MUST run with `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`, else it is stored as `!C:/Program Files/Git/audits/legfix5/` and silently does nothing. AppXSvc cannot be stopped even elevated (1051 dependent WSAIFabricSvc; then "cannot be stopped"; taskkill access denied); only a reboot frees it (see `appxsvc-leak-pythonmanager-2026-09-23`).
s10.why: "see `appxsvc-leak-pythonmanager-2026-09-23`" names a memory file

s10.old: - **Reboot + finalize plan (Paul 09-23 00:3x: "When it is ready to reboot, reboot"; earlier: "Once you are done building do a one-to-one, finalize, and then debug"):** the lean build run is `wf_de0fe38b-a24` (script `ui-finish-lean`). When it completes: reboot (`shutdown /r /t 120`), which frees AppXSvc (41.7 GB commit) and the grown pagefile. After restart (Paul reopens this session): Paul restarts 8841 (his), then launch the FINALIZE workflow: one-to-one audit of every Melange screen (integration stage `SP\stage\integration`, boards /1.867) and every Mentat screen (boards /1.25) by two Fable auditors each + debug sweep (console, interactions, data: Mentat Insights Recipients "-" and $0 new/no-longer bars; PAC maps nearly empty; Melange Influence Targets 7 rows vs board 12 (`build_clean_workspace` `ORD.slice 7`), Color default Field record vs Overall standing, Industry leftover Posture wording panel), then fix (one writer per product), re-audit until clean, apply Melange to LIVE hash-guarded (`APPLY_MANIFEST.md`; run LIVE `build_clean_workspace.py`), publish a report Artifact with side-by-sides + scores. No commits.
